title: Expressivity of IQP Feature-Map Quantum Kernels via Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.23692v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum kernels are among the most promising methods in quantum machine learning, providing a natural way to embed data into high-dimensional Hilbert spaces via quantum circuits and capturing non-linear relationships in data. Their learning behaviour is governed by the function class they represent, which is formally characterized by the structure of the associated Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS). However, a theoretical characterization of this function class, and of how it depends on the choice of feature map and its hyperparameters, is still lacking. In this work, we focus on the Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial (IQP) feature map and derive a Fourier representation of the associated RKHS generators as finite sums of trigonometric functions evaluated on polynomially transformed input variables, with a finite set of accessible frequencies determined by the circuit construction and scaled by the bandwidth hyperparameter. translated_title: 基于再生核希尔伯特空间的IQP特征映射量子核的表达能力研究
translated_abstract: 量子核是量子机器学习中最有前景的方法之一，它提供了一种通过量子电路将数据嵌入高维希尔伯特空间的自然方式，并能捕捉数据中的非线性关系。量子核的学习行为由其所表示的函数类决定，而该函数类在形式上由相应的再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）的结构来刻画。然而，目前仍缺乏对这一函数类及其如何依赖于特征映射选择和超参数的理论刻画。在本工作中，我们聚焦于瞬时量子多项式（IQP）特征映射，推导出了相应RKHS生成元的傅里叶表示，即以多项式变换后的输入变量求值的三角函数的有限和，其中可访问频率的有限集合由电路构造决定，并由带宽超参数进行缩放。这一结果……
tldr: 本研究在再生核希尔伯特空间框架下为IQP特征映射量子核推导出傅里叶表示，从理论上刻画了其所表示的函数类，并揭示了可访问频率集合由电路构造决定且受带宽超参数缩放的规律。
en_tdlr: This work derives a Fourier representation of the RKHS generators for IQP feature-map quantum kernels, theoretically characterizing their function class and revealing that the accessible frequency set is determined by the circuit construction and scaled by the bandwidth hyperparameter.
